claim: Costco's disclosed revenue totaled $63.7 million during the fiscal Q2 period of 2025.
summary: Costco's fiscal Q2 2025 revenue was on the order of $60+ billion, not $63.7 million. The stated $63.7 million figure is three orders of magnitude too low and is contradicted.

sub_claims.text: Costco's disclosed revenue totaled $63.7 million during the fiscal Q2 period of 2025
sub_claims.note: From general knowledge Costco is a ~$250B+ annual revenue retailer with quarterly revenue on the order of $60B+ in early 2025; $63.7 million is ~1000x too low and corresponds to ~$63.7 billion scale.
